🎉 Barcelona · Mon 16 Nov
Renfe/Rodalies strike all day Tuesday 17: about 75% of trains at peak hours, 50% otherwise. Metro and buses are not part of it.

TODAY · Mon 16 Nov

1. Language Exchange & Board Games + Pool & Darts & JAMBOREE DISCO (FREE)
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 06:00 · 📍 La Pecera del Pool
📊 50 going on Meetup (limit 150) · group has 49,925 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 The biggest social of the night: language exchange, board games, pool and darts, then free entry to Jamboree's club for anyone who wants to carry on.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811212/

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Mon, hours not stated · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,358 likes on @planesenbarcelona's round-up post
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80 · runs to 29 Nov
💬 City-guide pick: hop between Sant Antoni bars for a tapa and a drink at each. Easy to do with friends before anything else tonight.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

3. NOMAD RUN ★ 6KM with Entrepreneurs & Digital Nomads feat. La Fabrica &Co ROOFTOP
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Fabrica & Co
📊 22 going on Meetup · group has 15,677 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 A 6 km run with founders and digital nomads that ends on a rooftop; the most useful crowd tonight if you want to meet tech people.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/316897801/

4. Jamboree Jam Session
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Jamboree Jazz Club
📊 #6 of 11 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 5 followers on Xceed
💶 €12
💬 The Monday jazz jam at Jamboree on Plaça Reial, a long-running weekly session and the best live music option tonight.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/jamboree-jam-session-29/250166

5. Skylab at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 10 interested on RA
💬 House music on the 26th floor of the W with the skyline behind the DJ; dressy, over-21s, and done by 2 am.
https://ra.co/events/2550923

TOMORROW · Tue 17 Nov

1. Ed Maverick
🕘 Tue 21:00 → 23:45 · 📍 Razzmatazz
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €39.80
💬 Mexican indie-folk singer with a big following playing Razzmatazz, the largest concert in town on a quiet Tuesday.
https://dice.fm/event/6ab10423ee16640001e0e8ec

2. Weekly Barcelona Digital Nomads & Entrepreneurs Networking Meetup
🕘 Tue 19:00 → 22:00 · 📍 TBA
📊 61 going on Meetup · group has 15,677 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 The weekly nomads and entrepreneurs meetup, the biggest networking social of the day and an easy room to walk into alone or with friends.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/317282972/

3. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Tue, hours not stated · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,358 likes on @planesenbarcelona's round-up post
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80 · runs to 29 Nov
💬 City-guide pick, still on if you skip it Monday: a cheap tapas crawl through Sant Antoni that works as dinner before a gig or a club.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

4. Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tue 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 34 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 Tuesday's main club night: electronic music at Noxe on top of the W, free on the guest list, with an international crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2569424

5. LANGUAGE EXCHANGE & SALSA-BACHATA ALL LEVELS + JAMBOREE DISCO (FREE)
🕘 Tue 20:00 → 06:00 · 📍 Sabor Cubano de Gracia
📊 43 going on Meetup across 2 listings · group has 49,925 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Salsa and bachata classes for all levels mixed with a language exchange in Gràcia, then free entry to Jamboree afterwards.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811214/
